note: Stage-close proof of the Memoir MIDs the first scenario does not reach: chest 2307 with stock key, copied player fight 2311 with server report, monster fight 2314/2310, revive 2315 and abandon 2312. Map tiles use the registered touch callbacks, one step along client-known road cells; revive uses the stock model request because the VC cannot touch the reborn list cell, and the team preview's start button is fired through its own callback because a hero cell overlaps it in the layout-free VC. Either battle outcome is accepted and asserted by the server's replies. Next floor 2308 and final award 2313 need a guardian win and stay native proof.
steps: lua:local p=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.SELF_PLAYER) for _,h in pairs(p:getHeros()) do local hero=h if hero:getLevel()<xyd.tables.player:heroMaxLev(p.lev) then p:addPartnerExp({item_id=50001005,partner_id=hero:getHeroID(),item_num=100,total_num=p:getBackpack():getItemNumByID(50001005)},function(code,req,reply) if code~=xyd.error.OK or not reply.partner_exp then error('vc-training-failed') end hero:setExp(reply.partner_exp,xyd.tables.player:heroMaxLev(p.lev)) p:getBackpack():setItemNumByID(reply.item_id,reply.total_num) end) end end

lua:vcm={} function vcm.w() return xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('memories_of_school') end function vcm.touch(x,y) local w=vcm.w() local n=w.mapNodes[y][x] local ls=n._LuaListeners[cc.NODE_TOUCH_EVENT] if type(ls)~='table' then error('vc-memoir-no-listener-'..x..'-'..y) end for _,l in ipairs(ls) do l.listener_({name='began'}) l.listener_({name='ended'}) end end function vcm.step() if not vcm.kinds then return end local w=vcm.w() local sx,sy=w.currentPointX,w.currentPointY local key=function(x,y) return y*100+x end local prev={[key(sx,sy)]=false} local queue={{sx,sy}} local head=1 local dirs={{1,0},{-1,0},{0,1},{0,-1}} while queue[head] do local cx,cy=queue[head][1],queue[head][2] head=head+1 for _,d in ipairs(dirs) do local nx,ny=cx+d[1],cy+d[2] if w.map[ny] and w.map[ny][nx] then local kind=w.map[ny][nx] if vcm.kinds[kind] then if cx==sx and cy==sy then vcm.kinds=nil vcm.reached={nx,ny} vcm.touch(nx,ny) return end local bx,by=cx,cy while true do local p=prev[key(bx,by)] if p and p[1]==sx and p[2]==sy then vcm.touch(bx,by) return end bx,by=p[1],p[2] end elseif kind==0 and prev[key(nx,ny)]==nil then prev[key(nx,ny)]={cx,cy} table.insert(queue,{nx,ny}) end end end end error('vc-memoir-no-path') end
